purpose.en: Supports simple-tense questions, negatives and emphasis when no other auxiliary or modal is carrying that function.
purpose.es: Apoya preguntas, negaciones y énfasis en tiempos simples cuando ningún otro auxiliar o modal cumple esa función.
purpose.pt: Dá suporte a perguntas, negativas e ênfase em tempos simples quando nenhum outro auxiliar ou modal cumpre essa função.

position.declarative: subject + DO + lexical-verb, chiefly for emphasis

purpose.en: Builds progressive and passive constructions and can itself invert with the subject in questions.
purpose.es: Construye estructuras progresivas y pasivas y puede invertir directamente con el sujeto en preguntas.
purpose.pt: Constrói estruturas progressivas e passivas e pode inverter diretamente com o sujeito em perguntas.

position.interrogative: question-word? + BE + subject + complement or participle

purpose.en: Builds perfect constructions and carries auxiliary behavior when functioning as the perfect auxiliary.
purpose.es: Construye estructuras perfectas y se comporta como auxiliar cuando cumple la función de auxiliar perfecto.
purpose.pt: Constrói estruturas perfeitas e se comporta como auxiliar quando cumpre a função de auxiliar do perfeito.

purpose.en: Expresses modality such as ability, possibility, permission, obligation, prediction or willingness and directly carries interrogative and negative auxiliary behavior.
purpose.es: Expresa modalidad como capacidad, posibilidad, permiso, obligación, predicción o voluntad y asume directamente el comportamiento auxiliar interrogativo y negativo.
purpose.pt: Expressa modalidade como capacidade, possibilidade, permissão, obrigação, previsão ou vontade e assume diretamente o comportamento auxiliar interrogativo e negativo.

purpose.en: Carries the central lexical meaning of the action, state or event.
purpose.es: Lleva el significado léxico central de la acción, estado o evento.
purpose.pt: Carrega o significado lexical central da ação, estado ou evento.

position.declarative: after the subject or after the auxiliary chain
position.interrogative: after the subject when an auxiliary or modal has moved before the subject

formRequirements: MODAL requires the following lexical verb in base form.
Perfect HAVE requires the following lexical verb in past-participle form.
Progressive BE requires the following lexical verb in present-participle -ing form.
MODAL is followed by base HAVE.
Perfect HAVE requires the lexical verb in past-participle form.
Perfect HAVE requires BE in past-participle form: been.
Progressive BE requires the lexical verb in present-participle -ing form.
Perfect HAVE requires BE as been.
Progressive BE requires the lexical verb in present-participle -ing form.

rules.diagnosis: A modal already carries the auxiliary function in this interrogative structure, so DO support must not be added.
When BE is the finite verb or auxiliary, it forms the question by inversion and does not require DO support.
A core modal is followed by the base form of the next verb, not a third-person or past inflection.
Standard English does not normally stack two core modal auxiliaries in the same modal slot.

example.output: She will be able to go.

rules.diagnosis: Perfect HAVE selects a past participle, so the following lexical verb must use its past-participle form.
Progressive BE selects a present participle, so the following lexical verb must use its -ing form.

rules.pattern: perfect HAVE + BE not in past-participle form + lexical verb
rules.diagnosis: Inside a perfect-progressive chain, HAVE selects the past participle BEEN before the progressive -ing lexical verb.

rules.pattern: auxiliary chain outside MODAL + HAVE + BE + lexical-verb order
rules.diagnosis: Auxiliary functions occupy an ordered chain. For modal perfect progressive constructions, the functional order is MODAL + HAVE + BEEN + lexical verb in -ing form.
